desc: Parse input + simulate walk to get (cell, value) per query; implement brute-force O(HW)-per-query DP solver as correctness reference.

Implement fast solver: left/right DP frontier stacks around Takahashi's current column, affine update `ans += (new-old)*L[r]*R[r]`, lazy L/R repair on vertical moves, optional transpose to minimize `rows * horizontal_moves`, no division (zeros safe).
Verify frontier-stack solver vs brute-force full DP on small random cases including zeros, repeated cells, direction reversals, and boundary cells.

Drop obsolete time-sqrt chunk algorithm and transfer-matrix/segment-tree lines of work (superseded by the frontier-stack approach, which is strictly simpler and faster: O(HW + Q + min(H*#LR, W*#UD))).
